description: This file declares the SimpleFileTracker class, which manages open file handles within a disk cache system, ensuring resource limits are respected and providing thread-safe access to files associated with cache entries.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker
classes.description: Manages open file handles for cache entries, ensuring limits are not exceeded and providing thread-safe access.

classes.name: SimpleFileTracker::FileHandle
classes.description: RAII helper class that manages access to a file handle, ensuring safe usage and proper cleanup.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Associates a file with a cache entry and subfile, transferring ownership to the tracker.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Provides a handle to a file for use, managing resource limits and re-opening if necessary.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases interest in a file, allowing it to be closed and cleaned up.

methods.name: Doom
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as doomed, updating its doom generation to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: IsEmptyForTesting
methods.description: Checks if the tracker has no active in-memory state; intended for testing.
